Sibal has called for an investigation into the electoral rolls and recent elections conducted in Bihar and West Bengal. In response, the Election Commission acknowledged concerns and proposed several corrective measures to address them.

candidates.title: Russian Strikes Kill Four in Ukraine, Damage Kyiv Data Center
candidates.excerpt: Russia’s overnight airstrikes killed at least four people across Ukraine and hit a data center in Kyiv, according to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

candidates.title: 'Didn't collect ID': Guwahati homestay where student, ‘lover’ stayed 5 times sealed
candidates.excerpt: Nimisha Thakuria's death has prompted police to seal Rudra’s Kitchen homestay at Dharapur. Investigators are examining guest documentation and prior visits made by her and Ashiq Ali. Police indicated that Ali's claim of suicide has not yet been confirmed. The circumstances surrounding Nimisha's unconscious state and subsequent death are being explored. Authorities are investigating all possible angles related to the case.

candidates.title: UP double murder: Retired Army man, 1st wife found dead in pool of blood
candidates.excerpt: In a tragic event, retired Army veteran Shamsuddin and his wife Saddo Begum were discovered murdered in their residence, the police alerted by neighbors. Their bodies were located amidst a pool of blood, prompting forensic experts and a dog squad to join the inquiry. With the motive still unknown, multiple investigation teams are being formed.

candidates.excerpt: Kunal Ghosh, a Trinamool Congress MLA, alleged an attempted murder on his way to a program in Kolkata. Ghosh accused the BJP of involvement and criticized the police response to these incidents.
